vignette: A child is receiving high-dose head and neck radiation and has developed a dry mouth. The child is already being followed by the dental team during cancer treatment.
stem: Which approach to reevaluating this child's oral health during treatment is most appropriate?

options.text: Reevaluate at an interval shorter than 6 months because of the dry mouth risk.
Reevaluate every 6 months with no change, regardless of the dry mouth.
Wait until cancer treatment is completely finished before any reevaluation.
Reevaluate only if the child later reports symptoms.
